label: The Problem
heading: Your Sales Team Is Leaking Revenue
subheading: Most sales teams lose deals not because of bad products — but because of broken processes.

items.title: Missed Follow-Ups
items.description: Your sales reps forget to follow up with 40% of qualified leads. Deals slip through the cracks silently.

items.title: Manual Lead Qualification
items.description: Reps waste hours qualifying leads that never convert. Your best closers are stuck on low-value tasks.

items.title: Zero Pipeline Visibility
items.description: No clear view of deal stages, bottlenecks, or forecasting. You're managing revenue blindfolded.

items.title: Headcount Dependency
items.description: Scaling revenue means hiring more reps. Your growth is directly tied to payroll — not efficiency.
